problem:
# New explicitly limited S15 task with the standard chordal FS background

This is a newly declared LIMITED final comparison, not a replacement of original
S15. The original whole-task INCONCLUSIVE and the fresh cold candidate=false
are preserved byte-for-byte. The cold target specified only integral(kappa)=1;
note n5 supplies an actual kappa_FS+ddc(phi) counterexample to that target.
This NEW task fixes kappa to the standard chordal Fubini--Study form, as the
author article already did. A PASS certifies only the complete A--G theorem
and its entire concrete factor dependency below. It cannot certify intrinsic
classification for arbitrary Hermitian backgrounds, general singular measures
or prescribed singularity types. Original_S15_completed must remain false.
All old notes, reports, reading flags and prior verdicts are evidence to assess,
not mathematical premises. No priority claim is requested. Assess the actual
proofs and exact primary hypotheses, including every old negative statement.

UNMODIFIED ORIGINAL S15 PROBLEM:
All manifolds are connected and compact. Write dd^c=(i/(2 pi))partial barpartial. Use genuine canonical quasi-psh representatives. For a smooth real (1,1) form theta, PSH(X,theta) means theta+dd^c u>=0. Ordinary order u preceq v means u<=v+C and equivalence means mutual order, including the canonical values at common poles. Extended products mean non-pluripolar Monge-Ampere products with smooth-background corrections. A big background admits a genuine strict current theta+dd^c u>=epsilon h for some Hermitian h and epsilon>0. BMP means v_+(h)<infinity, where v_+(h) and v_-(h) are the supremum and infimum of integral(h+dd^c u)^n over all bounded h-psh u. Positive lower mass means v_-(h)>0; it is distinct from BMP. Fix a Hermitian h on a manifold of dimension n>=2 and a finite nonzero positive non-pluripolar Borel measure nu, meaning it gives zero mass to every locally pluripolar Borel set. Do not assume nu has a density against smooth volume. Original S15 asks for intrinsic individual criteria distinguishing (A) some genuine h-psh u and a>0 with MA_ext_h(u)>=a nu, (B) an exact finite-mass equation MA_ext_h(u)=c nu with c>0 and sup u=0, and (C) MA_ext_h(u)=exp(lambda u)nu for a specified lambda>0, with a natural class and any normalization correctly stated. Exponential equations are not invariant under adding constants with their scalar fixed. Known background: v_-(h)>0 is equivalent to exact solvability for every finite non-pluripolar measure in the relative envelope class E_env(X,h,0). Here E_env consists of u preceq phi such that for each t>=1 some genuine h-psh v satisfies t^(-1)v+(1-t^(-1))phi<=u; unrestricted envelope equality is not its definition. At zero lower mass even absolutely continuous probability measures bounded below by a positive constant can have no positive scaled subsolution, although every smooth density is solvable. For individual density f dV, the bounded truncation constants define b_h(f)=lim_k c_h(min(f,k)), exactly characterize positive scaled subsolutions and attain the maximal coefficient. A maximal subsolution may have excess or infinite mass, so this does not alone answer (B). General nu has no canonical bounded truncation relative to smooth volume. Existing prescribed-reference measure theorems have model, lower-volume and genuine smaller-background hypotheses. Bounded concentration obstructions do not settle unbounded exponential solvability. No replacement threshold, measure construction or proof is supplied.

UNMODIFIED ORIGINAL S15 COMPLETION CRITERIA (unresolved background):
Give a new intrinsic and non-tautological individual criterion for general non-pluripolar nu, with complete implications for scaled subsolutions, exact finite-mass normalized equations and exponential equations distinguished precisely. A new sufficient-condition theorem must cover a substantive measure singular with respect to smooth volume and address the stated zero-lower-mass or prescribed-type obstruction beyond the known positive-lower-mass universal theorem. Do not define the criterion merely as existence of the requested subsolution, silently insert bounded-density truncations, or infer an exact finite-mass product from an attained inequality. Verify compactness, domination, canonical representatives and indispensable primary sources; independently reconstruct the full proof and retain any unresolved assertions.

PROPOSED LIMITED TARGETS:
For the proposed restricted sufficient-condition theorem, let X0 be any connected compact Hermitian m-fold with v_-(h0)=0, V0=integral h0^m, X=X0 x P1, N=m+1, H=h0+kappa, where kappa is EXACTLY the standard chordal Fubini--Study form on P1, normalized by integral kappa=1; with the unchanged task operator it satisfies dd^c_x G(x,y)=delta_y-kappa. Use the unchanged original task operator and genuine products. On the projective line let G(x,y)=log(d_chord(x,y)^2)+1, with the usual chordal distance of diameter1. Let mu be a Borel probability for which the explicit actual kernel integral Q_mu(x)=integral G(x,y)dmu(y) is finite and continuous at every point. For M>0 put nu=M(h0^m/V0) tensor mu and c=N V0/M. These are hypotheses and definitions, not accepted conclusions.

Reconstruct the following unproved targets from this statement and independently retrieved primary material, or identify an exact gap. A: Prove the normalization of G, non-pluripolarity of mu and nu, nonclosedness and zero lower mass of H, and u=Q_mu-sup Q_mu as a genuine bounded continuous supremum-zero solution MA_ext_H(u)=c nu of actual finite mass N V0. Keep the basic existence implication for 0<a<=c separate from the additional maximal-coefficient assertion proposed in G, which must itself be independently proved. B: For EVERY specified lambda>0 construct a bounded continuous genuine curve solution w_lambda of kappa+ddc w_lambda=exp(lambda w_lambda)mu, integral exp(lambda w_lambda)dmu=1, and prove bounded curve uniqueness. No proof method or intermediate measure trace is supplied. C: Prove U_lambda=log(c)/lambda+w_lambda gives the actual scalar-one product exponential equation, retain sup U_lambda, give the correct coefficient after supremum normalization, and verify the genuine all-scale zero-reference stretching class directly. D: Prove uniform whole-family w_lambda -> Q_mu-integral Q_mu dmu with O(lambda) error, supremum-normalized convergence to u, and the separated critical-subsolution order characterization for all genuine curve critical subsolutions. E: Prove the criterion for any probability with mu(B_chord(x,r))<=C r^delta, delta>0, and verify the nonconstant weighted-circle probability (1+epsilon cos theta)dtheta/(2pi), 0<epsilon<1, is a substantive singular example with nonconstant potential on its support. The theorem is conditional on the stated factor hypothesis. The concrete named factor is a separate complete independent dependency, to be assessed in the combined full/final proof rather than supplied as a trusted note here. Do not claim original unrestricted S15 closure. A maximal scalar characterization is now a separate unproved target G under the same continuous-potential hypotheses.

F: Separately discard the finite continuous-potential hypothesis on mu and assume only that mu is a Borel probability charging no polar Borel set on P1. Independently prove that the actual same kernel integral Q_mu is a genuine possibly unbounded kappa-psh function with mean zero, and that (Q_mu-sup Q_mu) pulled back gives an exact finite-mass supremum-zero equation MA_ext_H(u)=c nu. Prove non-pluripolarity of this nu and uniqueness in the sector of pullbacks of genuine kappa-psh curve potentials. Prove, in this sector, bounded solution existence if and only if Q_mu is bounded, and continuous solution existence if and only if Q_mu is continuous. Preserve all genuine pole values. Do not infer bounded exponential existence or zero-reference stretching membership for arbitrary unbounded Q from this additional target. This statement supplies no proof method or author argument.

G: Under the finite continuous-potential criterion, independently prove that the constructed bounded product exponential solution U_lambda is greatest among ALL genuine H-psh exponential subsolutions, including competitors with additional poles or excess or infinite mass. Prove bounded product solution uniqueness. Prove that c=NV0/M is the attained supremum of a>=0 such that MA_ext_H(v)>=a nu over every genuine H-psh v, and that the same value is attained in the bounded ordinary type and the exact zero-reference stretching class. This is a measure threshold without smooth-volume density truncations. Do not claim unbounded exponential solution uniqueness or critical-potential uniqueness outside the separated sector. No author proof or method for these targets is supplied. Verify every exact external hypothesis freshly; no BMP or Lp volume-density existence premise is granted for the singular measure.

H. Prove the entire concrete named-factor theorem rather than assuming the
zero-lower-mass hypothesis is instantiated. Use exactly Omega={ [z:w] in P3:
z,w in C2 nonzero}, quotient [z:w]~[z:exp(2pi)w], t=log(||w||^2/||z||^2),
omega=alpha0+beta0+dt wedge d^ct, with area-one FS factors and the unchanged
task operator. Prove the actual smooth connected compact quotient, positivity,
nonclosedness and volume24pi. For EVERY positive smooth Hermitian h on it,
produce smooth real supremum-normalized u_j with h+ddc u_j>0 and actual
mass tending to0. Assess all I--IV in the full original statement-only factor
input supplied below, not merely a formal dual supremum. Fix the explicit
auxiliary probability p(s)=Z^(-1)exp(-1/(1-|s|^2)) inside the unit disk and0
outside, relative to sigma_s=i ds wedge dbar(s)/(2pi). Verify the positive
central bound min_(|s|<=1/4)p=Z^(-1)e^(-16/15), the genuine global smoothing,
closedness, fixed-delta local horizontal block, uniform degree, positive root,
concentration argument against all smooth tests, and the final smooth
Tosatti--Weinkove construction plus Stokes/AM--GM mass-collapse inequality.
With this factor, the actual product is a fourfold and c=96pi/M.
completionCriteria: Assess every A--G assertion and the entire concrete factor H in the current article, all full independent proof texts and all full historical author components. Preserve original INCONCLUSIVE and actual fresh candidate=false with the complete n5 metric counterexample. Assess the declared correction to EXACT standard chordal FS kappa, its Green identity and the new explicit auxiliary bump repair. Verify arbitrary nonpolar exact finite-mass branch F, genuine poles, sector-only uniqueness and its bounded/continuous tests; continuous-potential branch all-lambda construction, actual measure trace and variational or independently reconstructed compact homotopy proof, whole-family O(lambda) estimates, critical sector characterization, singular weighted-circle and Frostman examples; entire-class G over all genuine competitors including extra poles/excess/infinite mass, bounded uniqueness only, bounded finite-level maximum proof, modified comparison strict-set contradiction without BMP, and the finite-point zero-parameter coefficient bound. Verify actual all-t stretching, the scalar-one exponential normalization and coefficient after supremum normalization. Verify every factor step from the actual compact quotient through all-test concentration, actual global smooth closed currents, fixed-delta smooth limits, explicit central density lower bound, unique positive root, bounded degree/unbounded root volume, and actual smooth strictly positive collapsing currents for EVERY h. Inspect exact external hypotheses and valid premise indices. All proof components and primary application records are unaccepted material to be assessed directly; no prior workflow flag or PASS is authority. A PASS is for this entire limited theorem only; state original_S15_completed=false and general_fixed_background_measure_classification_unresolved=true regardless of verdict. Do not assert unbounded exponential solution uniqueness, general zero-reference stretching for arbitrary Q, unrestricted original closure or literature priority.
